_comment: Charged techs (issues #8, #24). Every field hero has five, one per weapon skill level (level 1 knows the first; each level up to 5 teaches the next, data/gear.json "skills"). With a full power gauge, hold Attack: the first tech is ready after stage_hold[0] seconds, the next one the hero knows after stage_hold[1], and so on; releasing fires the last one reached. A tech picked in the quick menu's Techs tab charges on its own instead (ready after its own stage time). Keyed by hero id (data/heroes.json), a list in level order. Every tech: id (unique), name, desc, color (glow, blast and preview), fx (how the blast looks, drawn in scripts/tech_fx.gd: burst, slash, sweep, line, beam, seal, shock, spiral, pillar, shards, splash, stars, coins, petals), sound (synthesized in scripts/techs.gd: tone Hz, sweep Hz over the clip, noise 0-1, len s, ring 0-1 bell overtone, thump 0-1 low boom). Blast: mult = damage as a multiple of the hero's full-power swing (0 = no blast, e.g. only knives), reach px radius, arc degrees either side of facing (180 = all round), offset px in front of the hero where the blast is centred, knock = knockback (negative pulls enemies in), step = px the hero lunges first (untouchable while it does). Optional: hits + every (that many blasts, every s apart; last = overrides for the final one), chain + chain_gap + chain_delay (extra blasts marching forward), delay (s before it goes off; its area is marked on the ground meanwhile), spread (degrees: one blast per angle), knives {count, arc total degrees, speed, range, mult, pierce}, stun s, mark s + mark_mult (Audited), execute (enemies at or below this share of max HP take double), taunt s (enemies hit go for the hero), guard + guard_time (hero takes that much less damage), vanish s + crit (out of sight; next landed swing x crit), heal / shield + shield_time (allies inside the blast), ink (Ink to every ally within 120 px), leech + leech_cap (that share of damage dealt heals allies within 90 px, each up to cap).

ash.name: Full Stop
ash.desc: Ash jabs the quill-knife into the page and the full stop bursts: a blast just in front that hits everything around it.

ash.name: Comma Splice
ash.desc: Two quick strokes, one on top of the other, in a wide arc in front. Grammatically wrong; very effective.

ash.name: Ellipsis
ash.desc: Three full stops in a row, marching away from Ash. Clears a corridor straight ahead.

ash.name: Redaction
ash.desc: A thick black bar struck through everything on one long line. Whatever it covers is stunned for 1 s.

ash.name: The End
ash.desc: Ash writes the last two words of the page on the ground. A beat later they go off: a huge blow all around, anything below 30% health takes double, and the party inside is patched for 6.

bran.name: Breach of Contract
bran.desc: Bran stops negotiating. A huge, slow cleaver arc in front of him that sends Nibblers flying.

bran.name: Fine Print
bran.desc: Bran reads them the small print. Everything around him is roughed up and dragged in close, right where his cleaver wants it.

bran.name: Hostile Takeover
bran.desc: A slam that hits everything around him. Whatever it hits comes for Bran for 5 s, and he takes half damage while they try.

bran.name: Severance
bran.desc: One enormous cleaver arc in front, a long way out. Everything inside it is knocked flat and stunned for 1 s.

bran.name: Liquidation
bran.desc: Three ground-shaking blows all around him, the last the hardest, and it stuns. All assets must go.

gristle.name: Stir the Pot
gristle.desc: A full turn of the bone ladle. Hits everything around her and splashes allies inside with 6 HP of broth.

gristle.name: Ladle Out
gristle.desc: Seconds for everyone. A splash that stings enemies around her and gives every ally inside 8 HP and an 8-point shield for 6 s.

gristle.name: Simmer
gristle.desc: She sets something down a way in front. It boils over a moment later: big damage and a stun to whatever is standing there. Watch the bubbles.

gristle.name: Bone Broth
gristle.desc: The good stuff. Hits everything around her, heals allies inside for 16, and gives the whole party nearby 3 Ink.

gristle.name: The Whole Cauldron
gristle.desc: She tips the whole thing over. Four scalding waves all around: each hurts enemies and heals allies inside for 4, and the last knocks them flat.

ninefingers.name: Skewer
ninefingers.desc: Daro lunges the full length of the pike. A very long, very narrow line that hits hard. Aim it.

ninefingers.name: Twin Prongs
ninefingers.desc: Both prongs, both sides: two long, narrow thrusts in a V. Catch one enemy between them, or two on them.

ninefingers.name: Run Through
ninefingers.desc: Daro charges a pike's length forward, through everything in the way, and can't be touched while running.

ninefingers.name: The Wheel
ninefingers.desc: The pike goes round twice at full length. Nothing near Daro stays standing.

ninefingers.name: Concord Breaker
ninefingers.desc: The thrust Daro was trained never to use on people. The longest, hardest line in the party, and it stuns everything it passes.

ottoline.name: Through the Door
ottoline.desc: Ottoline throws her whole weight into one punch. Whatever it hits leaves at speed and lands stunned.

ottoline.name: One-Two
ottoline.desc: Left, then right, in front of her. The second one sends them off stunned.

ottoline.name: Bar Brawl
ottoline.desc: She clears the room: everything around her is thrown back and stunned, and she shrugs off 40% of the damage for 3 s.

ottoline.name: Throw Them Out
ottoline.desc: First she hauls everything around her in by the collar, then she throws it all out at once. The second blow stuns.

ottoline.name: Closing Time
ottoline.desc: Both fists come down after a breath. The biggest stun in the party: everything around her is out for 2.5 s.

jessamy.name: Cut and Run
jessamy.desc: Jessamy darts straight through the crowd, cutting everything she passes, and is gone before they turn round.

jessamy.name: Hook and Haul
jessamy.desc: Both hooks out in front, then a yank. Whatever they catch is dragged to her feet.

jessamy.name: Knife Storm
jessamy.desc: Eight knives in every direction at once, each one going straight through whatever it meets.

jessamy.name: Smuggler's Route
jessamy.desc: She takes the hidden way through the crowd, cutting everything she passes, and disappears for 2.5 s. The next swing she lands does 2.5x damage.

jessamy.name: Midnight Tithe
jessamy.desc: Five cuts in a blur all around her; the last finishes off anything below 35% health. Then she's gone for 2 s.

odile.name: Final Demand
odile.desc: A great brass seal slams down a good way in front of her. Anything it doesn't flatten is Audited for 6 s.

odile.name: Compound Interest
odile.desc: She opens an account on everything around her: a light blow, and everything hit takes 60% more damage from everyone for 8 s.

odile.name: Garnish
odile.desc: Wages garnished at the source. A blast a little way ahead; half of the damage it deals comes back as health to the party nearby.

odile.name: Repossession
odile.desc: Three seals stamped in a row, marching forward. Everything under them is hit and Audited for 4 s.

odile.name: Writ of Erasure
odile.desc: A writ the size of a cart slams down well ahead. Everything under it is flattened, stunned and Audited for 8 s, and the party nearby gets 4 Ink back from the paperwork.

velvette.name: Coup de Grace
velvette.desc: One perfect thrust down a very narrow line. Anything already below 35% health takes double. Curtain.

velvette.name: Flourish
velvette.desc: Three thrusts fanned out, faster than the eye can follow: three deadly lines across a wedge in front.

velvette.name: Encore
velvette.desc: The same thrust three times down the same line, each one finishing off anything below 35% health.

velvette.name: Balestra
velvette.desc: A hop forward and a lunge from it, all in one motion. Hits very hard down a long line, stuns, and finishes off the wounded.

velvette.name: Curtain Call
velvette.desc: Fauvette takes her bow and the stage comes down around her. Hits everything nearby, and anything at half health or less takes double.
